claims: The 2026 Masters Tournament is the 90th edition.
The 2026 Masters Tournament will be held April 6–12, 2026.
The 2026 Masters Tournament will be held at Augusta National Golf Club in Augusta, Georgia.
Practice Rounds for the 2026 Masters Tournament are April 6–7, 2026.
Par 3 Contest for the 2026 Masters Tournament is Wednesday, April 8, 2026.
Tournament Rounds for the 2026 Masters Tournament are Thursday, April 9–Sunday, April 12, 2026.
Tickets for the 2026 Masters Tournament are sold exclusively through the Augusta National Golf Club.
Ticket applications for the 2026 Masters Tournament typically open in June 2025 via the official Masters website.
The application process for 2026 Masters Tournament tickets usually opens in June 2025.
The 2026 Masters Tournament field includes past champions Scottie Scheffler, Jon Rahm, Rory McIlroy, and Tiger Woods.
WDF World Masters (Darts) is scheduled for 2026 in Las Vegas.
Masters Tournament (Snooker) is scheduled for January 11–18, 2026, in London.
